lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, home notification, sign_in hint, and sign_in layout because each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder changes across 2 tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 1 test (+4.2%), while 2 other tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Sound & Action Primer Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive primer screen after home_intro where users test pet sound alerts and movement triggers before finishing setup.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple reports of post-onboarding confusion regarding how to interact with or control the desktop pet.

new_pet_primer.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_primer.body: Click below to preview pet actions, audio cues, and movement shortcuts.

guard.reason: Adds a new primer screen after home_intro which is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new finish screen showed -1.0% lift previously and requires high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Step Reordering
candidates.change: Moves sign_in after pet adoption screens (pick_friend, upload_photos, adoption_certificate) so users establish emotional attachment before signing in.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% and takes 89s median. Securing pet choices first increases motivation to complete account creation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after adoption screens is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage has highest drop-off (39.1%), but reordering steps historically yields modest gains.

candidates.title: Pet Naming and Personality Trait Selection Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a pet naming and behavior trait selection step right before certificate generation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (60.9% conversion) and highest completion time. A quick personalization step increases attachment and completion rate.

new_trait_selection.headline: Name & Personalize Your Pet
new_trait_selection.body: Give your companion a name and pick its main personality trait.

guard.reason: 'new_trait_selection.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Split Layout Home Intro Pet Command Summary
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a split layout with a visual companion preview on the left and quick controls reference on the right.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets complaining about missing desktop controls and unclear pet interactions after finishing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Review desktop companion controls before spawning your pet.

home_welcome.text: Right-click pet for menu • Double-click to pet • Press Esc to hide

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Live Pet Activity Teaser Stream During Wait
candidates.change: Shows animated activity teasers of the pet moving around on the waiting screen while background setup finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Providing active visual teasers reduces perceived wait time and abandonments.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home
waiting.body: Your pet is stretching its legs while we finalize generation.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information and adding pet animation preserves the waiting screen job and is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Proven positive track record (+1.9% over 3 tests) directly addressing extreme wait times.

candidates.title: Early Adopter Pet Accessory Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Displays an exclusive starter pet collar badge on pick_friend screen awarded upon adoption completion.
candidates.why: Adoption is the lowest performing funnel step (60.9%). An instant cosmetic reward encourages completing pet selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet today to unlock the exclusive Day 1 Companion Collar.
pick_friend.hint: Includes exclusive early adopter badge for your pet profile

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions exclusive bonus items/gifts ('Day 1 Companion Collar') and creates false urgency ('today'), violating Rule 3 and Rule 5.

candidates.title: Single-Account Sync Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Adds an inline sign-in hint emphasizing that pets are bound to the specific login method to prevent accidental multi-account creation.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again using a different login method.

sign_in.hint: Use your primary account so your adopted pets sync automatically across sessions.

guard.reason: Adding an informative account sync hint on sign_in is valid and complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: High support email evidence and config-only cost, with previous sign-in hint test showing +1.4%.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Comparison Cards Layout
candidates.change: Swaps the choose_path layout to two_column cards contrasting pre-made pets versus photo-based custom generation.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s, indicating confusion between available adoption options.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or build a unique pet from your photo.

path_options.text: Instant Pet Adoption | Custom Photo Pet

guard.reason: text in 'choose_path.replace.path_options[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['|']

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Ready Notification Switch
candidates.change: Adds a completion readiness toggle on home_intro to alert users the second their pet appears on the desktop background.
candidates.why: Three support emails reported pets not showing or users missing when the app finishes launching to desktop.

home_intro.hint: We will notify you on desktop as soon as your companion is rendered.

guard.reason: Adding a readiness notification toggle on home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes across home and sign_in consistently led to slightly negative returns.

candidates.title: Direct Photo Customization Value Headline Copy
candidates.change: Updates upload_photos headline to clearly explain how uploaded photos turn into an animated desktop pet.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet looks due to photo choice confusion.

upload_photos.headline: Transform Your Pet's Photo Into a Living Desktop Mascot
upload_photos.body: Upload a clear front-facing pet photo for best 3D desktop animation results.

guard.reason: Updating upload_photos copy to explain photo transformation is allowed and preserves the screen's function.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step with minimal effort, but previous copy and redesign tests yielded negative results.
